title: Close ordinary BIT interchange under heterogeneous recursive cycles
body:
This construction lets an ordinary BIT interchange run all its smaller ordinary swaps through a cycle of different words. One fixed multitape program serves each cycle from an elementary base. It accepts arbitrary input bits and needs linear visited backing. A word can participate even if it earns **zero** coarse saving of its own. [Theorem](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55805c63d974a55e9294741cbd06839f50f2e98d/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/PROOF.md) · [Complete caller and cost proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55805c63d974a55e9294741cbd06839f50f2e98d/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/APPLICATION.md) · [Reference implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55805c63d974a55e9294741cbd06839f50f2e98d/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/interchange.py) · [Exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55805c63d974a55e9294741cbd06839f50f2e98d/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/RESULT.json)

**Downstream consequence.** The selected paired word's own charged compiler fails the pending multiplier's tested price of 0.00387944011075. As the public entry to the new two-word cycle, it supplies at least 0.003879632977211447. Every smaller ordinary move in its companion calls back through the selected word. A second cycle exposes a public entry that only interchanges disjoint digit blocks. Both complete multiplier callers accept all four entry prices. The pending conditional multiplication exponent remains **κ = 0.00387944011068**. [Selected review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr7000-application/PROOF-REVIEW.md) · [Pending application](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/evidence/application.json)

| Cycle | Ordinary saving at first entry, rounded down | At companion entry, rounded down |
|---|---:|---:|
| Selected word with pending word | 0.003879632977211447 | 0.003879906746678229 |
| Cover-free block entry with pending word | 0.003879518297329907 | 0.003879906287958703 |

The weighted same-word children retain their original bad-class charge. Only the smaller unweighted instructions switch word. A child can retain its parent's entire bit volume, so the construction splits a complete spectator, returns every bit, then restores the parent. It charges both reversed bodies, weighted atoms, high routes, full-volume ragged blocks, stock, padding, parking and cleanup. The proof gives the charged characteristic with a fixed logarithmic factor and pure powers at the displayed prices. It also re-prices stock and movement on the outer multiplier's full tensor.

**Comparison and limits.** Four finite alternating stages already reach this particular tested price. One selected stage on the stronger previously completed pending backend reaches 0.00387965385578355. The theorem supplies input-dependent nesting, joint funding and a cover-free public producer with a proved complete consumer. The asymmetric selected entry incurs a necessary active-cover threshold of log₂(e) > 59,326,000,000,000,000. The full multiplication implication retains native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape and analytic_recovery. Independent scientific acceptance remains open.

**Source and credit.** The base is [canonical main at e545235](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57). @CubeJerry supplied the selected application and paired BIT construction in [PR #7000](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7000) and [PR #7001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7001). @Clear1nsight supplied the pending word and four-return proposal in [PR #7786](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7786) at [89a67c4](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/commit/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af). Its predecessor gate is retained from [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) at [4f7c67a](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f7c67ae387cc91580f469aeda4d508b372b9ec1/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/supplier_gate.py). @rohanarun supplied the finite bootstrap, @jmbarrancoml the two reached ordinary call sites and @mason-hale the segment allocation. Ali Romman (@aliromman) prepared this construction with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. **Verification.** From the repository root, use CPython 3.12 and its standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange
```

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange outcome=completed
```

All seven registered commands passed on the submitted commit and in a read-only Git-free export. They replay the signed entry prices, original interval gates, 54 source inequalities and four revalued functional inequalities for each application, and the weighted-tree and volume controls. Direct address checks cover 158,219 labelled stream positions and 97,686 high-route positions. The source depth check uses its actual compiler rank. Three separate Codex workers challenged the timing, space and consumer binding. The final native templates and numerical multiplier were not executed. [Verification and objections](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55805c63d974a55e9294741cbd06839f50f2e98d/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/VALIDATION.md) · [Application checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55805c63d974a55e9294741cbd06839f50f2e98d/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/check_application.py) · [Command manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55805c63d974a55e9294741cbd06839f50f2e98d/research/self-hosted-ordinary-interchange/VERIFY.json)

**Hosted status.** GitHub's shared onboarding test stopped the plan before package selection. The CI guide still specifies `make frontier6030-verify` while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The same test fails on the unmodified base. GitHub skipped the package replay. The seven local and exported scientific checks above completed on the submitted head.
